approach: Long-only trend heuristic: require positive trailing 20- and 40-bar log returns. Initially buy using cash divided by the latest close, buy slippage and fee factors, and an execution-price reserve of max(12%, four trailing-40-bar log-return standard deviations). Hold an existing long while both trends remain positive, otherwise liquidate. Unknown next-close execution means the reserve reduces but cannot eliminate infeasibility risk. Volume is not used because no reliable predictive relationship has been established.
